title: Poppy Playtime
provenance: Reported by im-theslimeguy (highball-db#684, 2026-10-25), Apple A18 Pro, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, D3DMetal environment, msync, vcrun2022, rated 2 of 5 after a 6-minute session: Chapter 1 perfect, Chapter 2 and Chapter 3 not playable, Chapters 4 and 5 not tried. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Chapter 1 reported perfect on an Apple A18 Pro with Apple's DirectX 12 support on the default engine. In the same setup Chapter 2 draws only red outlines of its models, and Chapter 3 shows a blank screen with the game's cursor once a new game starts, while its intro sound, menu and settings work. Chapters 4 and 5 not tried. Nothing was measured here.
